div.div:
No controller or service touches Student or Course, and CourseRepository is never injected.
They are leftover mappings only — ddl-auto still creates the student and course tables.

div.div:
Each association is owned by one side only (Interaction.customer, Student.course).
Deleting a customer that has interactions fails on the customer_id FK constraint.
